# Axis' Iliad

> Paste a code repository's address and get back the files AI coding tools read. Iliad turns a codebase into agent-ready context: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, MCP configs and the other artifacts its generator programs write. The output is deterministic: same input, same output, every run.

## Pages

- [Home](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/): point Iliad at a repository and get the files AI coding tools read
- [Documentation](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/docs/): how to run Iliad against a codebase, what each generator produces, and how to wire the output into an agent workflow
- [Programs](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/programs/): every generator program, with the files each one writes
- [Examples](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/examples/): sample runs against real codebases and the artifacts they produced
- [MCP server](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/mcp/): connect Iliad to Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code or Claude Code over the Model Context Protocol
- [For agents](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/for-agents/): the machine-readable entry point: tools, free discovery endpoints, budget-aware pricing headers, and how an autonomous agent should call Iliad
- [Pricing](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/pricing/): free files from every program (Search, Skills and Debug in full); plans for the rest, paid in monthly credits
- [Changelog](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/changelog/): release history: new generators, API changes and fixes
- [Feedback and support](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/feedback/): report a bug, request a feature or ask a question
- [Terms of Service](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/terms/) and [Privacy Policy](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/privacy/)

## Programs

- [Search](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/programs/search/): codebase analysis and context graph (free)
- [Skills](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/programs/skills/): governance files for every coding assistant (free)
- [Debug](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/programs/debug/): debug playbooks from the dependency graph (free)
- [Frontend](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/programs/frontend/): frontend rules, component guidelines and CSS scaffolding
- [SEO](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/programs/seo/): technical SEO rules, schema.org markup and sitemap strategy
- [Pitch](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/programs/pitch/): a pitch deck from runtime evidence, with documentation claims audited
- [Optimization](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/programs/optimization/): token budget planning, prompt optimization and cost analysis
- [Theme](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/programs/theme/): a CSS design system, design tokens and a dark mode theme
- [Brand](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/programs/brand/): brand guidelines, messaging system and channel rulebook
- [Superpowers](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/programs/superpowers/): refactoring checklists, test generation rules and a workflow registry
- [Marketing](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/programs/marketing/): developer marketing campaigns, funnels and CRO playbooks
- [Notebook](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/programs/notebook/): a research notebook, study brief and citation index
- [Obsidian](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/programs/obsidian/): an Obsidian vault for a developer knowledge base
- [MCP](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/programs/mcp/): Model Context Protocol config, connector map and tool manifest
- [Artifacts](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/programs/artifacts/): component library, dashboard widgets and embeddable snippets
- [Remotion](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/programs/remotion/): code visualization video scripts and Remotion templates
- [Canvas](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/programs/canvas/): a visual architecture canvas, planning board and workflow maps
- [Algorithmic](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/programs/algorithmic/): generative art, parameter packs and variation matrices from code
- [Agentic Purchasing](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/programs/agentic-purchasing/): checkout hardening with AP2, dispute evidence and policy controls
- [Closer](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/programs/closer/): packaging artifacts for distribution, launch and marketplace readiness
- [Deploy](https://iliad.trustfabric.ai/programs/deploy/): production deploy scaffolding for Docker, Render and Cloudflare

## API

The API is at https://api.iliad.trustfabric.ai and describes itself at [/llms.txt](https://api.iliad.trustfabric.ai/llms.txt), [/for-agents](https://api.iliad.trustfabric.ai/for-agents) and [/v1/docs](https://api.iliad.trustfabric.ai/v1/docs).

- MCP endpoint: `POST https://api.iliad.trustfabric.ai/mcp`
- Create an API key: `POST https://api.iliad.trustfabric.ai/v1/accounts`
- Analyze a repository: `POST https://api.iliad.trustfabric.ai/v1/analyze`
- Find a tool by keyword: `GET https://api.iliad.trustfabric.ai/v1/mcp/tools?q=`
